caption:
92 UK Labour MPs call for Rosebank oilfield to be rejected

Their letter to the prime minister says approving the project would 'permanently damage our climate credentials'. The Guardian reports that a handful of frontbenchers joined scores of party colleagues in signing the letter. The signatories urge Burnham not to let ministers approve the project. The Guardian describes the letter as exposing a split in Labour over the giant oilfield.

Reported by Financial Times; The Guardian.
